name: Golden Summit & Sea of Clouds
description: A breathtaking high-resolution landscape capturing a majestic snow-covered mountain peak rising dramatically above a vast sea of clouds. Illuminated by the warm, golden-orange and pink hues of a rising or setting sun, the rugged mountain ridges and icy slopes stand in sharp contrast to the soft, rolling mist filling the valleys below. The foreground reveals snow-dusted ridges covered in evergreen pine forests, enhancing the grand scale of this serene, epic wilderness. An inspiring and peaceful natural scene, perfect as a desktop or mobile background.

name: Midnight Apex – Orange GT86 / Scion FR-S
description: A moody, high-contrast visual featuring a custom orange sports coupe parked inside an underground parking garage at night. Glowing headlights illuminate the pavement, casting a sleek blue-white light against the dark, textured asphalt and concrete pillars. With its wide body stance, aggressive aero lip, white custom wheels, and low-slung profile, this shot captures the true essence of modern JDM tuner culture and nocturnal street aesthetics. Perfect for car enthusiasts seeking a clean, dark-themed desktop or live video wallpaper.
